title: Window, bay
text:
20.02.1152 Window, bay.
"Bay window" means a window or set of windows extending out from a wall of a building and forming an alcove within; the overall width of such alcove not to exceed one-half of the width of the wall from which it protrudes. The bay window may rise from the ground level or from some point above ground level.
(Ord. 16653 § 2 (part), 2007)
